summary: Four churches, each with one Sunday Mass (St. Mary's Kirkwood also Saturday 4:00 pm), listed on the front page of all three bulletins read. Also settled: Wednesday 12:10 pm Mass and 1st/3rd Saturday Reconciliation at St. Mary's, Tuesday noon Open Adoration at St. Joseph's Deposit, and a first-Wednesday 5:00 pm Holy Hour that the bulletin places in the Deposit box (the newest issue's week holds no first Wednesday, so it is cited from the Oct 4 issue). The newest bulletin is Oct 11. No open questions.
